rules.title: Tracked target documents must follow their declared source
rules.text: When a source file declared in .gate-keeper/dependency-manifest.yml changes in a PR, every target document that tracks it must change too — or a reviewer ack at .gate-keeper/acks/<edge-id>.yml must cover the current source sha. The validator dispatches by `to:` path, so this rule covers every manifest edge when invoked with the matching --target.
